If I ask myself "what did I learn in ENG102?", the answer is nothing. The course doesn't teach nearly anything that ENG101 didn't already teach. Writing an essay, writing introduction, writing conclusion, referencing, paraphrasing, hedging, preparing a presentation; they all are things that we already learned in 101. The only major difference is that you are the one that finds sources this time. Is 5 hours a week necessary to teach just that? Absolutely no. There is no reason that I can think of that explains why this course is 5+1 hours per week. Despite the assessment periods, the lessons are pretty much just reading texts. Most of the time we were left by ourselves to read some text or to work for the essay/research paper. Man I can work by myself in the library, in a more quite environment, or I can read the texts myself, why do I come to class for that purpose? I do not think this is a problem with the instructor. If even she cannot find something meaningful to fill the time, doesn't it prove that 5 hours is not necessary? I don't have a problem with the assessments though, I think they successfully serve their purpose. But still, they are not really different than the 101 assessments.
